name: block-destructive-commands
description: Best-effort guard against destructive commands: rm -rf targeting absolute, home, or root-adjacent paths; git push --force (not --force-with-lease); git reset --hard; git clean -f; kubectl delete; terraform destroy. Known bypass classes include aliases, quoted arguments, non-standard clients, and scripts that invoke these commands indirectly. This is friction, not a security boundary. [Session-enforced via a PreToolUse hook; fails open (allows) if python3 or a usable bash is unavailable.]
